exits.hold: hold to the close (expiry value = intrinsic at the 15:59 close)
exits.take2x: sell all at 2× (a 1-min bar high touches 2×)
exits.take2x_close: sell all at 2× only on a 1-min CLOSE ≥ 2× (filled at that close)
exits.take3x: sell all at 3× (bar high), else hold
exits.half2x_trail: sell half at 2×, trail the rest: out on a 1-min close ≤ 60% of its peak, else expiry
exits.stop50: stop at −50% (bar low; gap fills at the open), else hold
